---
name: Hardware report
about: Tell us how Power Gauge runs on your Mac, even if everything works
labels: hardware
---

Power Gauge has only been tested on a few Macs, so a report from yours helps, even if nothing is
wrong.

1. Open both panels and choose Monitor > Start Monitoring….
2. After a minute, choose Help > Save Diagnostic Report… and attach the file here. It gives your
   Mac's model, macOS version, processor and GPUs, and what the app reads from them, and
   nothing personal.

**Anything showing n/a, missing or looking wrong?**
